name: llama.cpp (CUDA llama-server) on NVIDIA
description: AccelMark runner for NVIDIA GPUs using llama.cpp llama-server (CUDA backend) with continuous batching and native SSE streaming TTFT/TPOT measurement.
notes: Requires GGUF checkpoint (--gguf-path or runner_config.gguf_path; convert HF weights losslessly to BF16/F16 GGUF for Suite A/D/F/H accuracy gate). Upstream: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp
